about.what: post-hoc maps of hier-ship's stored predictions fitted leave one parent out, update-speed and B0 calibrations, and budget-wise switching between configurations (R5): every cheap lever on top of hier-ship, measured 2026-10-06, ported
about.plan: docs/plans/p2_final_plan.md section 2 (last bullet) and R5; the v2 outline's T4 row 6 and App F.8
about.sign: delta = ALC(lever) - ALC(hier-ship); negative means the lever is better

modes.lopo: fit on TL+mix appearances of the other parents (the primary reading)
modes.lopo4: fit on all four regimes' appearances of the other parents
modes.ins: fit and score in sample per regime (a ceiling, not a lever)

about.weights: maps and damping fit with each run weighing 1; update_speed, update_conditional and b0_stretch with each regime weighing 1 (w_raw) or hidden-v (w_hv); scores raw (run mean of pairs) and hidden-v
about.se: (parent, subject) cluster bootstrap with the fit held fixed (a lower bound); 2,000 resamples in maps, 1,000 elsewhere
about.verdict_rule: negative if the LOPO TL delta exceeds both 2 SE and 0.0001, or a public regime loses more than 0.001; passes only at TL delta <= -0.002 with the public guard held; null otherwise
about.feedback_use: results/formative/run1-3.txt B0 sections: 26 values v = B0 - ECE0^2 pooled into three bin shares for the hidden-v weights; no id is read into the results
about.harness_rows_library: 3f75a549673aae6a (archive-3's code: the corrected multiple-choice floor and the floored-fit fix; docs/findings.md, the acceptance harness)

runshift.label: run-level shift from other pairs' labels

bba.label: blend with a Beta-binomial learner on hier's B0 mean

pat.label: lambda by the pair's own label pattern

disp.label: lambda by the run's label dispersion

bwa.label: B0 stretch with its centre fitted

checks.check: harness rows: 650 runs, 5,371 appearances, one library
26 formative pairs; both probes' hidden-v shares agree
RS rows hold exactly the 11 configurations the switch uses
every printed scratch value and stated number reproduces at its precision or is explained

printed.explanation: critic.md (section G) wrote 'lambda at B1 is 0.65 without multi_swebench and 0.95 to 1.07 without each other parent'. The largest of the four other folds is 1.0647 (researchcodebench held out), 1.06 at two decimals; upd_probe.json stores it unrounded, and 1.07 rounds its three-decimal print (1.065) a second time. The reading is unchanged: 0.65 against 0.95 to 1.06.

the ledger (section 2G) gives c_k 'about 0.36 at B1/B3'. At B3 the five folds give 0.105 (multi_swebench held out), 0.295, 0.315, 0.362 and 0.364 (matharena and real_webagents held out): 0.36 is the value of two folds, the median is 0.315. At B1 the median is 0.357 (0.36).
the ledger's 'about 0.07 at B31': the five folds give 0.067 to 0.083, median 0.0751 (0.08 at two decimals).
